item.title: Lincolnshire NHS Trust pays out over £3m in compensation following radiology errors
item.description: New findings reveal that radiology mistakes have cost the NHS millions in the past five years, highlighting ongoing pressures within NHS diagnostic services. Figures obtained by Medical Negligence Assist found that, since 2020, United Lincolnshire Teaching Hospitals NHS Trust has had to pay out over £3 million to patients who have lodged claims following radiology errors.
